name: Hello, Codin
desc: Your first verified pass. The platform is alive and so are you.

name: First Commit
desc: You made a git commit with your own hands - status, add, commit, push.

name: Two Places at Once
desc: Progress recorded from a second device. Your learning now travels with you.

name: Wayfinder
desc: Navigation and file wrangling complete - the terminal is a place you can move through.

name: Daily Driver
desc: The daily git loop - status, add, commit, pull, push - is yours now.

name: Keymaster
desc: Permissions understood: who may read, write, and run - and why.

name: Pipe Dream
desc: You chained small tools into one pipeline and made the shell sing.

name: Persistence Pays
desc: Files, JSON, and errors handled in Python - including the platform's own brain.

name: Conflict Mediator
desc: Two branches disagreed. You heard both sides and merged the truth.

name: Branch Manager
desc: Branching and merging complete - parallel work no longer scares you.

name: Automator
desc: You wrote real shell scripts that do real work while you watch.

name: Platform Engineer
desc: You changed the platform's own code, on a branch, merged through a real pull request.

name: Toolsmith
desc: A personal toolbelt of your own commands lives in bin/.

name: Shipped It
desc: A working CLI app - yours, from an empty file to a thing people could use.

name: JOINed Up
desc: Tables modeled, keys related, JOINs written - data has structure now.

name: Data Custodian
desc: You migrated the platform's progress cache into SQLite - a real ETL, run on your own data.

name: Quizmaster
desc: The dashboard's quiz mode got its next version - built by you.

name: Bug Exorcist
desc: The debugging dojo, cleared. Bugs are specimens, not curses.

name: Badge Smith
desc: You wrote a badge rule of your own - and it awarded itself from history you had already lived.

name: Nothing Is Ever Lost
desc: You resurrected work from the reflog. Git forgets almost nothing; now you know it.

name: v1.0
desc: You tagged your platform's first release.

name: Front Page
desc: A stats page and an SVG skill tree, designed and built by you, live on your dashboard.

name: First Segfault
desc: Caused on purpose, diagnosed with a debugger, explained in your own words.

name: The Whole Story
desc: You narrated, end to end, how a program becomes a process.

name: Shellwright
desc: You wrote a shell in C - and used it to commit to this repo. The summit.

name: Polyglot
desc: The same program, shipped three times: shell pipeline, Python, and C.

name: Exercise Author
desc: You authored a Codin exercise from the blank template - the platform now teaches what you decide.

name: Explainer
desc: "How Linux works, as far as I can tell" - published, with your own strace captures.

name: Self-Hosted
desc: The dashboard runs on your own server, on your own network, because you put it there.

name: Comeback
desc: Away a week or more, then back with a verified win. Returning is the whole skill.
